name: GET /api/auth/me - Read the caller's own user projection
description: Returns the public projection of the account that owns the presented session token - never the password hash. Protected by the authenticate guard, so the Authorization header is required even though this is a GET. Used by the client to hydrate the session on page load and to decide which navigation entries a persona may see. QA: depends on login, whose captured token is presented here.

testCases.name: Reject a request with no Authorization header

errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, or present without a Bearer token
the bearer token fails signature verification, has expired, or is missing required claims
the token verifies but the user it names no longer exists
